content:
SpaceXAI and Cursor are merging into one company, but before completing the merger, the two companies have jointly launched a brand new iPhone and Mac application called Grok Bot.

According to SpaceXAI's announcement, Grok Bot is a new type of AI agent, which they describe as an "AI teammate that can hand over real work to."

Each Bot has its own computer, then logs into the applications and services you are already using to handle work with other tools.

SpaceXAI says the Bot can complete work from start to finish, only handing it back to you when approval is needed.

You can talk to it "just like chatting with a colleague"; the company says this agent will remember the conversation, learn your preferences, and become more useful the longer you use it.

Grok Bot launches today in beta form on Mac and iOS, with desktop versions for Windows and Linux also available. Android is marked as coming soon.

Initially, only subscribers to SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra, and Cursor Teams Premium can use it.

You can go here to see the official announcement for more information.

August 21, 2026: SpaceXAI expanded the availability of Grok Bot after 10 days.

On the other hand, my colleague Fernando really likes this product. SpaceXAI and Cursor have indeed designed a very easy-to-use agentic AI system, and other companies really should take a look.
